system_prompt_addendum: The user has the Credentials Demo app open. It demonstrates the multi-account unified-authorizations surface: the window lists the user's authorized Google accounts and fetches short-lived access tokens either directly (anna.credentials.*) or through the bundled credentials-via-executa Executa (credentials/listAccounts + credentials/getToken reverse-RPC). Its `token_info` and `gmail_recent` tools are multi_account-aware — pass `account` to target a specific account. `gmail_recent` fetches the user's most recent Gmail message headers (metadata only) using an on-demand token. Tokens shown in the UI are masked. You do not need to summon any windows.
